== Summary ==
Complete eight-page June 2023 edition of the [[Players Committee]] printable release sheet for [[Virtual Set 21]]. Each page is marked ‘SWCCG Players Committee, June 2023’. This is the historical June edition, not the later December 2023 edition distributed from the same publisher address.

* Original publisher address: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet].
* Preserved historical edition: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Internet Archive, 26 June 2023].
